name: Toushin Upsilon
source:
Toushin Upsilon is one of the few remaining Toushin in the current era. It was deactivated many years ago and was hidden in the floating continent Ylapu, guarded by [url=/c97706]Replica Misly[/url]. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Toushin_Upsilon]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
